summary: Iteration 4 (rewarded ad — double-XP after match + 3-min cooldown) verified end-to-end on the public HTTPS base. Backend: 6/6 pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_rewarded_ads.py pass. (1) GET /api/ads/status for a fresh guest returns can_watch=false, reward=0, cooldown_remaining=0, already_claimed=false; (2) POST /api/ads/reward without a prior match returns 400 ('No reward available'); (3) after join+leave (patience_xp>0), status flips to can_watch=true and reward equals the persisted last_match_xp — confirmed reward == profile.progression.xp for a brand-new user; (4) POST /api/ads/reward returns 200 with rewarded==reward and user.xp increments by exactly that amount (i.e. DOUBLE the match XP once combined with the original match award); (5) after claim, status.can_watch=false, 0<cooldown_remaining<=180, already_claimed=true; (6) a second POST /api/ads/reward returns 400 ('Ad on cooldown'). Frontend E2E (mobile viewport 390x844): AdE2E14159 -> ENTER THE ARENA -> FIND MATCH -> lobby -> match active (~9s) -> panic-pressed to self-elim -> results-screen appears with recap-card + bonus-row -> ad-overlay renders with 'AD · ADVERTISEMENT · SIMULATED' header, blue 'GALAXY CLASH' banner + 5-star, 5s countdown -> ad-claim button unlocks -> tapping ad-claim shows ad-claimed 'DOUBLE XP! +552 bonus applied 🎉'. Cooldown UI verified with a fresh guest CD14400: match 1 -> claim ad -> return to lobby -> match 2 within seconds -> NO ad-overlay renders AND results-screen shows the cooldown note 'Next bonus ad in 3 min'. Regression: normal /api/match/join + leave -> results.xp_gained>0 still works (see TestAdsRegression). All 20+11+10 previous-iteration tests remain compatible; nothing was modified in server code.

ui_bugs.issue: 'Next bonus ad in 3 min' renders with low contrast on the dark results background (muted color on translucent gradient), making it hard to read at a glance. Reference: /app/frontend/app/match/[id].tsx:551

issues: Custom TTF fonts fail to decode via the Expo web preview proxy (OTS parsing error / invalid sfntVersion). Falls back to system font on web only. Carry-over from prior iterations, non-blocking, does not affect native builds.

react_native_issues.issue: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' warning surfaces on web console. Style already contains pointerEvents but React Native Web still flags the prop. Reference: /app/frontend/app/match/[id].tsx:302

(Optional/informational) Two DOM nodes carry data-testid="find-match-btn" simultaneously on the main menu (Expo Router keeps a hidden tab screen mounted). Not a functional bug — playwright must use ':visible' or nth() to disambiguate. Consider only rendering the active tab's testIDs if you want E2E-friendlier DOM.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py _ad_state() correctly gates on last_match_id + ad_claimed_for so a user cannot double-claim within the same match; combined with last_ad_at cooldown of 180s, this covers both accidental double-tap and manual replay.
server.py POST /ads/reward updates xp and level atomically via $inc/$set in one call — race-safe under single-user usage.

match/[id].tsx AdOverlay uses a hard-coded 5s local countdown; the reward is fetched from /api/ads/status (double the match XP). Web is the only testable path here because adsSupported=false on web/Expo Go, which correctly falls through to the simulated overlay (verified).
match/[id].tsx ResultsView useEffect fetches ads/status once on mount; the setAdCooldown branch drives the 'Next bonus ad in N min' note. Verified via a real second match within the cooldown window.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of iter4 UI ad flow steps (auth, find-match, results, ad-overlay, ad-claim → ad-claimed, cooldown suppression in match 2, cooldown note visible)

seed_data_creation: Ephemeral guest users created per test via POST /api/auth/guest; no persistent seed data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Rewarded-ad simulated path is the only path testable in Expo Go / web preview because real AdMob (react-native-google-mobile-ads) requires a native build. Backend base: https://button-royale-pvp.preview.emergentagent.com/api. Full ad flow: (1) POST /auth/guest; (2) POST /match/join; (3) poll /match/{id}/state until phase=='active'; (4) POST /match/{id}/leave (or press panic-button until self-elim) — a ~1-2s wait before leaving gives non-zero patience_xp; (5) GET /ads/status -> can_watch true, reward>0; (6) POST /ads/reward -> user.xp += reward, cooldown starts; (7) GET /ads/status -> can_watch false, 0<cooldown_remaining<=180. Frontend testIDs on the results-screen: ad-overlay, ad-skip, ad-claim (only after 5s local countdown), ad-claimed. The cooldown note is a plain <Text> INSIDE results-screen — no dedicated testID — search for the string 'Next bonus ad in'. NOTE for future E2E: main-menu 'find-match-btn' has a duplicate hidden DOM node; use '[data-testid="find-match-btn"]:visible' with .first to click reliably.
